description: COSMOPHY-X: Real-time operational spaceflight health monitoring and extremophile bio-defense platform. Integrates NASA OSDR/NCBI multi-omics data streams with daily astronaut vital signs (BP, Sugar, Sleep, Mood) to predict mission health risks and pair them with model extremophile countermeasures (Delta G docking verified).
summary: COSMOPHY-X is an advanced space biomedical simulation and real-time telehealth platform. It evaluates multi-system organ vulnerability across solar system environments, ingests NASA OSDR/NCBI multi-omics datasets, and matches extremophile defense mechanisms (heat-shock proteins & antioxidant enzymes) to mitigate space radiation and microgravity hazards. It features a dual-use Earth Telemedicine mode for remote terrestrial healthcare and an AI medical commander ('Priti') for step-by-step first-aid protocols.
details: COSMOPHY-X is built using Python and Flask for the backend, integrated with Google Gemini 1.5 Flash API for live conversational AI assistance, Chart.js for high-resolution interactive data visualization, and ReportLab for generating executive landscape PDF clinical dossiers. It bridges the gap between deep-space astronaut health monitoring and downscaled Earth-based rural telemedicine.
